findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router call log file does not exist at configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router service creates and writes to call_log.jsonl, and verify write permissions for logging directory.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router query history, token metrics, latency, and error diagnostics.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: observability_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Changes to running services require verification

findings.title: High model router average latency

evidence.observation: Recent average latency reported by model router is 60,746 ms (~60.7 seconds)

proposed_action.description: Investigate routing bottlenecks, warm-up times, and keep_alive configurations for high-latency models like mistral-small3.2:24b or external API calls.

findings.expected_benefit: Reduces inference latency and prevents downstream execution timeouts.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: performance_gap; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: high; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Performance changes require validation against baselines

findings.title: Direct LLM API invocations bypassing model router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral bypassing the centralized model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert processing to route requests through model router endpoints rather than direct vendor API helper calls.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures centralized auditing, policy enforcement, rate limiting, and fallback behavior.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
